editorialReview.modelVersion: Kling 4.0 Flash via fal kling/v4/flash routes
editorialReview.note: Six selected marketing outputs were reviewed through extracted frames and local ASR. This does not constitute full audiovisual criterion scoring or a matched benchmark. User selection approves placements, not numeric benchmark scores.

observations.observation: Four-shot space-hangar escape resolves with a blast-door closure. Local ASR detects Get behind me / We are clear. Final crew is back-facing; lip-sync quality is not established by transcription.
Four-shot siege sequence resolves with tower fire/collapse and defenders cheering. Bow release is not fully readable in extracted frames. Local ASR detects For the city.
Four-shot bus escape resolves after a bridge-gap jump. Local ASR detects Everybody hold on. Continuous-motion physics still requires full playback review.

criterionAssessments.requiredEvidence: Compare every requested action and conclusion against each complete original, retaining missing or invented beats.
Inspect original resolution, lighting, faces, background and material artifacts over complete clips.
Watch complete motion at native speed and inspect contact, camera trajectories and bridge/collapse physics.
Track identities, wardrobe, props and environment within and across the requested cuts.
Review visible hands, faces, limbs and interactions at full resolution.
Requires a readable requested-text sample; these prompts intentionally excluded text.
Listen to original audio while reviewing visible mouth movement; ASR alone is insufficient.
Timecode actual cuts against requested four-shot briefs and record identity/action continuity.
Review each paired I2V/REF source and output; API acceptance alone does not prove adherence.
Requires a complete native application attempt ledger; external imported clips do not qualify.
Relate active exact customer quotes to usable footage and the full attempt ledger before assessing relative value.

reviewProtocol.selectionPolicy: Keep all six attempts, exact prompts, mode, reference lineage, original hashes and measured duration. Do not pool image- or reference-guided runs with text-only scenes as matched observations.
reviewProtocol.reviewPolicy: Watch original full clips with sound; record timecoded observations for each relevant criterion against the existing 0–10 anchors, obtain a second review and retain disagreements. Unobservable criteria remain absent.
reviewProtocol.publicationPolicy: Publish reviewed numbers only in the existing score owner. Use editorial-estimated disclosure for non-controlled observations; do not label them controlled measurements. Never copy full Kling 4 scores or extrapolate from Flash capabilities.
reviewProtocol.latencyPolicy: External imports are not application delivery latency. Keep existing 30 completed jobs / 5 distinct users threshold for the rolling operational statistics.
